map.清单按区域/设备拆项为可勾选检查点（如灭火器压力、配电箱漏保、急停按钮有效）；未: The checklist breaks items down by area or equipment into tickable checkpoints (such as fire extinguisher pressure, distribution box leakage protection, emergency stop button effectiveness); unticked items are recorded as failures, summarized into a pending remediation list and tracked until acceptance.
map.月度巡检清单 30 项，本月不合格 4 项（消防 2、电气 1、机械 1），指派: A monthly patrol checklist of 30 items had 4 failures this month (fire 2, electrical 1, machinery 1); after assigning owners, 3 closed within two weeks and 1 electrical item was delayed by procurement and will close next month; compared with 6 failures last month, the trend is improving.
map.清单检查标准为什么要统一？: Why should checklist inspection standards be unified?
map.统一检查项与判定标准可避免不同人员松紧不一，使各期数据可比，便于发现系统性薄弱环: Unified inspection items and pass criteria avoid different people applying inconsistent strictness, make data comparable across periods, and help reveal systemic weak links.
map.反复出现的同类隐患怎么处理？: How should recurring hazard types be handled?
map.归因为根因（如设备老化、培训不足），升级为工程改造或制度修订，而非重复局部整改。: Attribute them to root causes (such as aging equipment or insufficient training) and escalate to engineering modification or policy revision rather than repeated local remediation.
